findings.text: the rewritten directory case asserts only the forward direction, a directory candidate against a live file claim, where the candidate is not in the list at all and the assertion passes whatever the second half of dispatch.py:1283 does; the reverse case, a listed-file candidate against a live directory claim, is the only configuration that reddens if candidate == claim.path is dropped, was asserted by the pre-change file, and is now asserted nowhere, so that invariant can regress silently (reviewer-probe.log case b shows in_list=True exact_match=False, result REFUSED).

the anchor states the base-arm log path is named on the manifest while the manifest records the base-arm gate log as not produced under follow_ons, so the cumulative evidence record carries an unmet promise and the done_when's comparison clause has no receipt.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; e99035f3 changes the two production modules, the shared list and the contract test, and c3474085 appends 70 lines to the evidence record and a landing section to the plan.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure names a contract test on the real dispatch path, its four cases, the list extension and an evidence anchor; tests/test_shared_claims_on_declared_hot_files.py:131 dispatches through crew.dispatch and its five tests pass at head (reviewer gate log: 5 passed, EXIT=0), docs/state/reckon/shared-write-paths.json:27-44 names the four modules with reasons, and the base-arm clause has no artifact.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is the shared-path exemption reaching the check a real dispatch raises from, with one claim check left; reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1269 reads the list and dispatch.py:1283 admits the exact named file, while reckon/crew/runs.py:825-855 turns _raise_live_scope_conflict into a delegate.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits e99035f3 and c3474085, a six-file gate at 55 passed in 72.10s, the negative-control log and driver, and it names the missing base-arm log under follow_ons rather than claiming it.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/runs.py, tests/test_shared_claims_on_declared_hot_files.py, docs/state/reckon/shared-write-paths.json, the evidence record, the figure topic and the plan file; every path in git diff 26b2f499..c3474085 lies inside them.

justifications.durability: the listed-file co-claim, the unlisted refusal and the absent-list refusal redden under the declared mutation (logs/negative-control.log:3), but the exact-match half of the dispatch.py:1283 predicate has no discriminating assertion.
justifications.evidence: the head gate is recorded and reproduces at head (reviewer-gate-contract-file.log: 5 passed, EXIT=0), but the base-arm clause of the done_when has no artifact, as the manifest's follow_ons concedes and the evidence anchor contradicts (docs/evidence/archive/the-local-lane-is-the-default-landed.html:841).
justifications.fit: the fix follows the module's idiom with the list read once into shared_files at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1225 and dispatch.py:1269, its comment states the mechanism, and no symbol or comment carries a plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the exemption is applied at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1283 through the same list reader runs._shared_write_paths, and the declared negative control shows the refusal raised from that real dispatch path.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path is declared, and the only excess is two formatter-only hunks at reckon/crew/runs.py:2891 and runs.py:2948 that ruff format produces on the staged file.
